description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_ID responsible for validating HTML 'id' attributes within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods to validate IDs based on configuration and context, handling prefixes, blacklist patterns, and ensuring ID uniqueness and validity according to HTML5 standards and custom rules.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_ID
classes.description: A class that validates HTML 'id' attributes, configurable for CSS selector validation and ensuring IDs are unique and conform to HTML standards.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the object, setting whether validation is in CSS selector mode.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given ID string based on configuration, context, and various rules such as prefix handling, blacklist patterns, and structural validation checks.
